text: A birth certificate can list a baby's size without predicting its whole life. Likewise, Paper 3's cited computer results say, later motion barely cares about starting size. It mainly follows a particle production setting. Mass enters the start but leaves no claimed later fingerprint. The join between black hole interior and baby universe is also a conjecture, meaning a proposed connection rather than a worked calculation. No horizon matching, no calculation showing how the inside joins the black hole's one-way boundary is provided. And the headline number block silently works only by choosing a starting size of one meter.
